wiki_article:
**The 3:60 Room — Room Specification and Contributor License: Maria** is a specification dated 29 April 2026, held in this record as a **metadata capture**.

It is the room-specification companion to the contributor license at #1364, which is seated in full. The Hexagon is organised as rooms — addressed positions in a semantic architecture, each with a hex coordinate, a specification, and named witnesses — and a room specification states what a room holds and how it is entered.

The record was assembled from a DataCite full-metadata capture after the 19 June 2026 termination, with no live authorial surface passing the body-head gate at restoration time. The captured fields stand verbatim in the body. Where a work exists in both a seated and a captured record, as here, the archive holds both rather than merging them, since the two documents were deposited separately and their identifiers resolve separately.
